description: The Chinese city energy-transition research team publishes an Energy Transition Index for 282 Chinese cities from 2003 to 2019. The index separates energy-system performance from transition readiness. The own deposit describes performance through two dimensions and seven components, and readiness through four dimensions and eleven components, covering energy conditions and socioeconomic capacity. Scores are available as an Excel workbook, free under CC BY 4.0. These annual city indicators can contextualise heterogeneous assumptions in energy-transition simulations such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that a composite index is not a direct measure of physical generation capacity or proof that a particular investment is feasible. Weighting, normalisation and missing-data choices affect comparisons and should be inspected in the associated method. The page announces planned annual updates, but the verified release covers 2003–2019 only. No workbook values were downloaded or recalculated.
